records.literal_gloss: And he will be to you for a restorer of life and to sustain your old age, for your daughter-in-law who loves you has borne him, who she [is] better to you than seven sons.

en.L: And he will be to you a restorer of life and a sustainer of your old age; for your daughter-in-law who loves you has borne him, she who [is] better to you than seven sons."
en.B: He will renew your life and take care of you when you are old. For your daughter-in-law, who loves you and means more to you than seven sons, is the one who has given birth to him."
en.R: This child will give you new life and look after you when you grow old. His mother is your daughter-in-law, who loves you. She is better to you than seven sons!"

sw.L: Naye atakuwa kwako mrejeshaji wa uhai na mtegemezaji wa uzee wako; kwa maana mkweo anayekupenda amemzaa, yeye aliye bora kwako kuliko wana saba."
sw.B: Atakuhuisha na kukutunza utakapokuwa mzee. Kwa maana mkweo, anayekupenda na aliye wa thamani kwako kuliko wana saba, ndiye aliyemzaa."
sw.R: Mtoto huyu atakupa uhai mpya na kukutunza utakapozeeka. Mama yake ni mkweo, anayekupenda. Yeye ni bora kwako kuliko wana saba!"

es.L: Y él será para ti restaurador de la vida y sustento de tu vejez; porque tu nuera, que te ama, lo ha dado a luz, la que es para ti mejor que siete hijos».
es.B: Él renovará tu vida y te sostendrá en tu vejez. Porque tu nuera, que te ama y que vale para ti más que siete hijos, es quien lo ha dado a luz».
es.R: Este niño te dará vida nueva y te cuidará cuando seas anciana. Su madre es tu nuera, que te ama. ¡Ella es para ti mejor que siete hijos!».

fr.L: Et il sera pour toi un restaurateur de vie et un soutien de ta vieillesse ; car ta belle-fille qui t’aime l’a enfanté, elle qui [est] meilleure pour toi que sept fils. »
fr.B: Il te redonnera vie et prendra soin de toi dans ta vieillesse. Car c’est ta belle-fille qui l’a mis au monde, elle qui t’aime et qui vaut mieux pour toi que sept fils. »
fr.R: Cet enfant va te donner une nouvelle vie et il s’occupera de toi quand tu seras vieille. Sa mère, c’est ta belle-fille, qui t’aime. Elle vaut mieux pour toi que sept fils ! »

vi.L: Nó sẽ là người phục hồi sự sống cho bà và là người nuôi dưỡng bà lúc tuổi già; vì con dâu bà, người yêu thương bà, đã sinh ra nó, là người đối với bà còn quý hơn bảy con trai."
vi.B: Đứa trẻ sẽ làm cho đời bà tươi mới lại và chăm sóc bà lúc tuổi già. Vì chính con dâu bà, người yêu thương bà và đối với bà còn quý hơn bảy con trai, đã sinh ra nó."
vi.R: Đứa trẻ này sẽ đem lại cho bà sức sống mới và chăm sóc bà khi bà già yếu. Mẹ của nó là con dâu bà, người yêu thương bà. Nàng còn tốt với bà hơn cả bảy con trai!"

ko.L: 그가 당신의 생명을 회복시키는 자요 당신의 노년을 돌보는 자가 될 것입니다. 당신을 사랑하는 며느리, 일곱 아들보다 당신에게 더 나은 그 며느리가 그를 낳았기 때문입니다."
ko.B: 이 아이가 당신에게 새 힘을 주고, 당신이 늙었을 때 당신을 돌볼 것입니다. 당신을 사랑하고 당신에게 일곱 아들보다 더 귀한 며느리가 이 아이를 낳았습니다."
ko.R: 이 아이가 당신에게 새로운 삶을 줄 것이고, 당신이 늙었을 때 당신을 돌볼 것입니다. 이 아이의 어머니는 당신을 사랑하는 며느리입니다. 그 며느리는 당신에게 일곱 아들보다 더 귀합니다!"

pt.L: E ele será para você aquele que faz voltar a vida e sustenta a sua velhice, pois a sua nora, que a ama, o deu à luz, ela que é melhor para você do que sete filhos."
pt.B: Ele vai renovar a sua vida e cuidar de você na velhice. Pois quem o deu à luz foi a sua nora, que ama você e que vale mais para você do que sete filhos."
pt.R: Este menino vai lhe dar vida nova e cuidar de você quando você ficar velha. A mãe dele é a sua nora, que ama você. Ela é melhor para você do que sete filhos!"

decisions.choice: a restorer of life: the answer to 1:21
decisions.reason: The words mean one who brings back a person's life or strength (Lamentations 1:16). Naomi had said that the LORD "brought me back empty" (1:21), using the same verb "bring back". Now the LORD has brought her life back.

decisions.choice: sustain your old age: provide for you when you are old
decisions.reason: The verb means to feed and support, as Joseph provided for his father's household (Genesis 47:12). An old widow without children had no one to depend on.

decisions.choice: better than seven sons: worth more than the fullest family
decisions.reason: Seven stands for completeness, and seven sons was a picture of perfect blessing for a mother (1 Samuel 2:5; compare 1 Samuel 1:8). Sons counted for much in that world; the women say Ruth's love is worth more than any number of them.

decisions.choice: His mother is your daughter-in-law
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the long clause into short sentences and turns "has borne him" into "his mother".

decisions.choice: aquele que faz voltar a vida
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses the verb "bring back" of Naomi's complaint in 1:21 (m1), which Literal rendered there "me fez voltar vazia"; "faz voltar a vida" keeps the echo, which "restaurador" would hide. Balanced and Readable say "renovar" and "vida nova", as the English does.

en.L: And Naomi took the child and laid him in her bosom, and became his nurse.
en.B: Then Naomi took the child, laid him on her lap, and cared for him.
en.R: Naomi took the baby boy and held him close in her arms. She took care of him.

sw.B: Kisha Naomi alimchukua mtoto, akamweka mapajani pake, akamlea.
sw.R: Naomi alimchukua mtoto, akamkumbatia mikononi mwake. Akamtunza.

es.L: Y Noemí tomó al niño y lo puso en su regazo, y fue su nodriza.
es.B: Entonces Noemí tomó al niño, lo puso en su regazo y lo cuidó.
es.R: Noemí tomó al niño y lo apretó en sus brazos. Ella lo cuidaba.

fr.L: Et Noémi prit l’enfant et le mit sur son sein, et elle devint sa nourrice.
fr.B: Noémi prit alors l’enfant, le posa sur ses genoux et prit soin de lui.
fr.R: Noémi a pris le bébé et l’a serré dans ses bras. Elle s’est occupée de lui.

vi.L: Na-ô-mi bồng đứa trẻ, đặt nó vào lòng mình, và trở thành người vú nuôi của nó.
vi.B: Na-ô-mi bồng đứa trẻ, đặt nó vào lòng mình, và chăm nom nó.
vi.R: Na-ô-mi bồng đứa bé trai và ôm chặt nó vào lòng. Bà chăm sóc nó.

ko.L: 나오미가 그 아이를 받아 품에 안고, 그의 양육자가 되었다.
ko.B: 나오미는 그 아이를 받아 무릎에 앉히고 그를 길렀다.
ko.R: 나오미는 그 아기를 받아 품에 꼭 안았다. 나오미는 그 아기를 돌보았다.

pt.L: E Noemi tomou o menino, e o pôs no seu colo, e se tornou a sua ama.
pt.B: Então Noemi pegou o menino, o pôs no colo e cuidou dele.
pt.R: Noemi pegou o bebê e o segurou bem junto de si, nos braços. Ela cuidou dele.

decisions.choice: nurse: one who looks after and brings up a child
decisions.reason: The word is not the usual word for a nursing mother. It is used of a man or woman who carries and cares for a child (Numbers 11:12; 2 Samuel 4:4; 2 Kings 10:1, 5). Naomi becomes the child's guardian.

decisions.choice: laid him in her bosom: holding him close as her own
decisions.reason: To hold a child to one's bosom shows love and care (2 Samuel 12:3; Numbers 11:12). Some see in the act a formal adoption of the child into Elimelech's family, but the text describes only the gesture.

decisions.choice: lap / arms; cared for him / took care of him
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use everyday words for "bosom" and say what "became his nurse" means (m1).

records.literal_gloss: And called to him the neighbor women [a] name, saying, has been born [a] son to Naomi; and they called his name Obed; he [was the] father of Jesse, [the] father of David.

en.L: And the neighbor women gave him a name, saying, "A son has been born to Naomi." And they called his name Obed. He [was] the father of Jesse, the father of David.
en.B: The women who lived nearby gave him a name. "Naomi has a son!" they said, and they called him Obed. He became the father of Jesse, David's father.
en.R: The women who lived near Naomi named the boy. They said, "Naomi has a son!" They named him Obed. Obed grew up to be the father of Jesse, and Jesse was the father of King David.

sw.L: Nao wanawake jirani wakampa jina, wakisema, "Mwana amezaliwa kwa Naomi." Wakamwita jina lake Obedi. Yeye [alikuwa] baba wa Yese, baba wa Daudi.
sw.B: Wanawake walioishi jirani walimpa jina. Walisema, "Naomi amepata mwana!" Wakamwita Obedi. Yeye akawa baba wa Yese, baba wa Daudi.
sw.R: Wanawake walioishi karibu na Naomi walimpa mtoto jina. Walisema, "Naomi amepata mwana!" Wakamwita Obedi. Obedi alipokua alikuwa baba wa Yese, na Yese alikuwa baba wa Mfalme Daudi.

es.L: Y las vecinas le dieron un nombre, diciendo: «Le ha nacido un hijo a Noemí». Y llamaron su nombre Obed. Él [fue] el padre de Isaí, el padre de David.
es.B: Las vecinas le pusieron nombre. «¡Noemí tiene un hijo!», decían, y lo llamaron Obed. Él fue el padre de Isaí, el padre de David.
es.R: Las mujeres que vivían cerca de Noemí le pusieron nombre al niño. Decían: «¡Noemí tiene un hijo!». Lo llamaron Obed. Obed llegó a ser el padre de Isaí, e Isaí fue el padre del rey David.

fr.L: Et les voisines lui donnèrent un nom, en disant : « Un fils est né à Noémi. » Et elles appelèrent son nom Obed. Il [fut] le père de Jessé, le père de David.
fr.B: Les voisines lui donnèrent un nom. « Un fils est né à Noémi ! » disaient-elles, et elles l’appelèrent Obed. Il devint le père de Jessé, le père de David.
fr.R: Les femmes qui habitaient près de chez Noémi ont donné un nom au garçon. Elles ont dit : « Noémi a un fils ! » Elles l’ont appelé Obed. Quand Obed a grandi, il est devenu le père de Jessé, et Jessé a été le père du roi David.

vi.L: Các phụ nữ láng giềng đặt tên cho nó mà nói: "Một con trai đã sinh ra cho Na-ô-mi." Họ gọi tên nó là Ô-bết. Ông là cha của Gie-sê, cha của Đa-vít.
vi.B: Các phụ nữ hàng xóm đặt tên cho đứa trẻ. Họ nói: "Na-ô-mi có con trai rồi!" và họ gọi nó là Ô-bết. Ông là cha của Gie-sê, cha của Đa-vít.
vi.R: Các phụ nữ sống gần Na-ô-mi đặt tên cho đứa bé. Họ nói: "Na-ô-mi có con trai rồi!" Họ đặt tên nó là Ô-bết. Lớn lên, Ô-bết là cha của Gie-sê, và Gie-sê là cha của vua Đa-vít.

ko.L: 이웃 여자들이 "나오미에게 아들이 태어났다" 하며 그에게 이름을 지어 주었다. 그들은 그의 이름을 오벳이라고 불렀다. 그는 다윗의 아버지 이새의 아버지였다.
ko.B: 이웃 여자들이 그 아이에게 이름을 지어 주었다. 그들은 "나오미에게 아들이 생겼다!" 하고 말하며, 아이의 이름을 오벳이라고 하였다. 그가 바로 다윗의 아버지 이새의 아버지이다.
ko.R: 나오미의 이웃 여자들이 그 아이의 이름을 지어 주었다. 그들은 "나오미에게 아들이 생겼다!" 하고 말했다. 그들은 아이의 이름을 오벳이라고 지었다. 오벳은 자라서 이새의 아버지가 되었고, 이새는 다윗 왕의 아버지였다.

pt.L: E as vizinhas lhe deram um nome, dizendo: "Nasceu um filho a Noemi." E chamaram o seu nome Obede. Ele [foi] o pai de Jessé, o pai de Davi.
pt.B: As vizinhas lhe deram um nome. "Noemi tem um filho!", elas diziam, e o chamaram de Obede. Ele foi o pai de Jessé, pai de Davi.
pt.R: As mulheres que moravam perto de Noemi deram nome ao menino. Elas disseram: "Noemi tem um filho!" E o chamaram de Obede. Obede cresceu e foi o pai de Jessé, e Jessé foi o pai do rei Davi.

decisions.choice: a son born to Naomi: the heir of her family
decisions.reason: Ruth bore the child, but as Mahlon's heir he belongs to the family of Elimelech and Naomi (verses 5, 10). The women speak of him as Naomi's son, the one who carries on her husband's line.

decisions.choice: Obed: "one who serves"
decisions.reason: The name comes from the verb "to serve" or "to worship". It may be short for a longer name such as Obadiah, "servant of the LORD".

decisions.choice: the neighbor women gave him a name: an unusual naming
decisions.reason: In the Bible the parents usually name a child (Genesis 30; 1 Samuel 1:20). Only here do the women of the neighborhood do it, as the town shares Naomi's joy. The "calling of a name" (verses 11, 14) now comes true.

decisions.choice: the father of Jesse, the father of David: where the story leads
decisions.reason: David's name is the last word of the verse. The loyalty of Ruth, Naomi and Boaz in the dark days of the judges (1:1) prepares the way for Israel's king. This is the first time David is named in the Bible.

decisions.choice: King David
decisions.reason: Readable adds "King" so young readers know who David is.

decisions.choice: "Obedi", "Yese", "Daudi", and in verses 18-22 "Peresi", "Hesroni", "Ramu", "Aminadabu", "Nashoni", "Salmoni", as in Matthew 1:3-6
decisions.reason: The New Testament already prints this family line in Swahili; the names here take the same forms, so that a reader can follow Ruth's line into the genealogy of Jesus. Literal keeps "Salma" in verse 20, where the Hebrew spells the name so.

decisions.choice: "Ô-bết", "Gie-sê", "Đa-vít"
decisions.reason: The forms published in Matthew 1:5–6, which the Joshua–Ruth terms note says win.

decisions.choice: Obede, Jessé, Davi
decisions.reason: The usual Brazilian forms, as in Matthew 1:5-6 in Portuguese; "as vizinhas" keeps the feminine of the Hebrew (m3) in one word.

records.literal_gloss: And these [are the] generations of Perez: Perez fathered Hezron;

en.L: And these [are] the generations of Perez: Perez fathered Hezron.
en.B: These are the descendants of Perez. Perez fathered Hezron.
en.R: Here is the family line from Perez to David. Perez was Hezron's father.

sw.L: Na hivi [ndivyo] vizazi vya Peresi: Peresi alimzaa Hesroni.
sw.B: Hawa ndio wazao wa Peresi. Peresi alimzaa Hesroni.
sw.R: Hii ndiyo orodha ya jamaa kutoka Peresi mpaka Daudi. Peresi alikuwa baba wa Hesroni.

es.L: Y estas [son] las generaciones de Fares: Fares engendró a Hezrón.
es.B: Estos son los descendientes de Fares. Fares fue padre de Hezrón.
es.R: Esta es la línea familiar de Fares hasta David. Fares fue el padre de Hezrón.

fr.L: Et voici les générations de Pérès : Pérès engendra Hesron.
fr.B: Voici la descendance de Pérès. Pérès engendra Hesron.
fr.R: Voici la liste de la famille, de Pérès jusqu’à David. Pérès a été le père de Hesron.

vi.L: Đây [là] dòng dõi của Pha-rê: Pha-rê sinh Ếch-rôm.
vi.B: Đây là dòng dõi của Pha-rê. Pha-rê sinh Ếch-rôm.
vi.R: Đây là dòng họ từ Pha-rê đến Đa-vít. Pha-rê là cha của Ếch-rôm.

ko.L: 베레스의 계보는 이러하다. 베레스는 헤스론을 낳았고,
ko.B: 베레스의 자손은 이러하다. 베레스는 헤스론을 낳았다.
ko.R: 베레스부터 다윗까지의 집안 계보는 이러하다. 베레스는 헤스론의 아버지였다.

pt.L: E estas [são] as gerações de Perez: Perez gerou Hezrom.
pt.B: Estes são os descendentes de Perez. Perez foi pai de Hezrom.
pt.R: Esta é a linhagem da família, de Perez até Davi. Perez foi o pai de Hezrom.

decisions.choice: these are the generations of: the heading of a family record
decisions.reason: The same heading opens the family records of Genesis (Genesis 2:4; 5:1; 11:27; 25:19; 37:2). It sets the story of Ruth among the great family histories of Israel. The same line, from Perez to David, appears again in 1 Chronicles 2:4-15 and in Matthew 1:3-6, which takes it on to Jesus and names Tamar, Rahab and Ruth among the mothers.

decisions.choice: ten generations from Perez to David
decisions.reason: The list names ten men, from Perez to David, with Boaz in the seventh place. Ancient family lists often counted in such set patterns and could leave out names; the list traces the line, not every generation. Hezron went down to Egypt with Jacob (Genesis 46:12).

decisions.choice: from Perez to David
decisions.reason: Readable says at once where the list leads.

decisions.choice: "engendra" (L, B); "a été le père de" (R); the names as in Matthew 1:3-6 ("Hesron", "Ram", "Amminadab", "Nahshôn", "Salmon", "Jessé")
decisions.reason: The genealogy keeps the forms of the same names in Matthew 1 and Luke 3 in this translation, as the terms note asks where a name is already published. Readable says "a été le père de", as the English Readable says "was ... father".

decisions.choice: "Ếch-rôm" for Hezron, and the other names of verses 18–22 as Matthew 1:3–6
decisions.reason: The Joshua–Ruth terms note says the New Testament form wins where a name is already published; the genealogy in Matthew gives these names in Vietnamese.

decisions.choice: "Đây là dòng dõi của" for "these are the generations of"
decisions.reason: The heading the Genesis note sets for *toledot* at Literal; Balanced keeps it, since the list that follows is a plain line of descent.

decisions.choice: "~의 계보는 이러하다" for "these are the generations of"
decisions.reason: As the terms of this translation set for the *toledot* formula in Genesis; the genealogy uses the forms of the names already published in Matthew 1:3-6.

decisions.choice: Perez, Hezrom; gerou (L), foi pai de (B), foi o pai de (R)
decisions.reason: For the list (verses 18-22): the names keep the forms of Genesis 38 and 46 and Numbers 26 in Portuguese (Perez, Hezrom) and of Matthew 1:3-6 (Rão, Aminadabe, Naassom, Salmom, Boaz, Obede, Jessé, Davi). "Gerou" is the Literal verb, as in Matthew 1 in Portuguese; Balanced and Readable say "foi pai de".

en.R: Hezron was Ram's father, and Ram was Amminadab's father.

vi.B: Ếch-rôm sinh A-ram, và A-ram sinh A-mi-na-đáp.
vi.R: Ếch-rôm là cha của A-ram, và A-ram là cha của A-mi-na-đáp.

pt.L: E Hezrom gerou Rão, e Rão gerou Aminadabe.
pt.B: Hezrom foi pai de Rão, e Rão foi pai de Aminadabe.
pt.R: Hezrom foi o pai de Rão, e Rão foi o pai de Aminadabe.

decisions.choice: Amminadab: a man of the time of the exodus
decisions.reason: Amminadab's daughter Elisheba married Aaron (Exodus 6:23). Ram is named in the same line in 1 Chronicles 2:9-10.

decisions.choice: Ram's father
decisions.reason: Readable says "was ... father" for "fathered" throughout this list (verses 18-22).

decisions.choice: "A-ram" for Ram
decisions.reason: The Hebrew name is Ram; Matthew 1:3–4 in Vietnamese gives "A-ram" from the Greek. The terms note's rule is followed so the two genealogies agree, but a reviewer may prefer "Ram".

decisions.choice: Nahshon: leader of the tribe of Judah in the wilderness
decisions.reason: Nahshon son of Amminadab led Judah when Israel left Sinai and brought the first gift at the altar's dedication (Numbers 1:7; 2:3; 7:12; 10:14).

decisions.choice: Salmah: the same man as Salmon in verse 21
decisions.reason: The name is spelled Salmah here and Salmon in the next verse; 1 Chronicles 2:11 has Salma. The spellings are forms of one name.

decisions.choice: Salmon
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable spell the name Salmon, as in verse 21, so readers see one person; Literal keeps the spelling of this verse.

decisions.choice: "Salma" (L); "Salmon" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew writes the name as Salmah here and Salmon in verse 21; it is one man (m2). Literal keeps the written form, as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable use "Salmon", the form of verse 21 and of Matthew 1:4-5.

decisions.choice: "Sanh-ma" (L), "Sanh-môn" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew spells the name Salmah here and Salmon in verse 21, the same man (meaning decision). Literal shows the spelling; the other levels use the form of verse 21 and Matthew 1:4–5.

decisions.choice: "살마" at Literal; "살몬" at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The Hebrew spells the name Salmah here and Salmon in the next verse; Literal keeps the spelling, the other levels use the one form, as in Matthew 1:4-5.

decisions.choice: Salmá (L); Salmom (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English, Literal keeps this verse's spelling of the name (m2), "Salmá", and Balanced and Readable say "Salmom", the form of verse 21 and of Matthew 1:4-5 in Portuguese, so readers see one man.

decisions.choice: Salmon fathered Boaz: Rahab in the line
decisions.reason: Matthew 1:5 names Rahab, the woman of Jericho who sheltered Israel's spies (Joshua 2; 6:25), as the wife of Salmon and the mother of Boaz. Ruth's book does not mention her.

decisions.choice: Boaz fathered Obed: the son counted as Mahlon's heir is listed as Boaz's
decisions.reason: The child was to carry Mahlon's name and land (verse 10), yet the family line lists him as Boaz's son. Both were true: in law he was Mahlon's heir, and by birth he was Boaz's son.

decisions.choice: Jesse fathered David: the book ends with Israel's king
decisions.reason: The book closes on David's name, as verse 17 does. The LORD's care for one widowed family in Bethlehem was part of his care for all Israel, and for the line of the king through whom he would keep his promises (2 Samuel 7:12-16).
